;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Surabaya bombings]]
**An Indonesian family believed to be connected to the terrorist group [[Jamaah Ansharut Daulah]] attacks police headquarters in [[Surabaya]]. The attack kills all four perpetrators and injures the perpetrator's daughter, six civilians, and four police officers. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-05-14/blast-at-suabaya-police-station/9758730 (ABC News)]

;Business and economy
*The [[Netherlands|Dutch]] government, following similar moves by the [[United States]] and the [[United Kingdom]], announces that it is phasing out the use of [[antivirus software]] products from the [[Russia]]n company [[Kaspersky Lab]] "as a precautionary measure". [https://www.nasdaq.com/article/dutch-government-to-phase-out-use-of-kaspersky-antivirus-software-20180514-01084 (Nasdaq)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Natural disasters in India]]
**Thunderstorms and lightning strikes kill up to 80 people in five states in [[India]], mainly in [[Uttar Pradesh]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/80-dead-136-injured-in-5-states-due-to-lightning-strikes-thunderstorms/articleshow/64162709.cms (''The Times of India'')]
*A pilot is injured when a cockpit window breaks and he is partially sucked out of the [[Airbus A319]] operating [[Sichuan Airlines]] Flight 8633. The aircraft lands safely at Chengdu. [http://avherald.com/h?article=4b890953&opt=0 (''The Aviation Herald'')]

;International relations
*[[United States recognition of Jerusalem as capital of Israel]]
**On the 70th anniversary of the [[History of Israel#State of Israel (1948–present)|formation of Israel]], the [[United States]] becomes the first country with an [[Consulate General of the United States, Jerusalem|embassy in Jerusalem]] after a dedication ceremony featuring [[Israel]]i leaders and [[White House]] advisers. [https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/05/14/610944471/u-s-dedicates-new-embassy-in-jerusalem (NPR)]
**Tens of thousands of [[Palestinians]] [[2018 Gaza border protests|protest on the border of Gaza]]. The [[Israel Defense Forces]] reports some in the crowds were planting or hurling explosives, and that many were flying flaming kites into Israel. The [[Gaza Health Ministry]] reports at least 58 killed and  over 2,400 wounded by Israeli forces using live fire and tear gas. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/05/14/world/middleeast/gaza-protests-palestinians-us-embassy.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/14/israel-palestine-defiance-death-gaza-jerusalem-suffers-horrific-day-of-violence-for-four-years (''The Guardian'')]
**Six-time [[Israeli Premier League]] champion [[Beitar Jerusalem F.C.]] officially renames itself Beitar Trump Jerusalem F.C. for [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s decision to move the embassy. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2018/may/13/beitar-jerusalem-donald-trump-us-embassy-israel (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
* The [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]], in [[Murphy v. National Collegiate Athletic Association|a case]] brought by [[New Jersey]] challenging the [[Professional and Amateur Sports Protection Act]] (PASPA), which prohibited [[U.S. state|state]]-sponsored [[sports betting]] outside of four [[Grandfather clause|grandfathered]] states, holds that PASPA is unconstitutional, opening the door for all states to authorize sports betting. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/14/politics/sports-betting-ncaa-supreme-court/index.html (CNN)]  

;Politics and elections
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**The Catalan parliament elects hard-line separatist [[Quim Torra]] to become the [[President of the Generalitat of Catalonia]] after obtaining 66 votes in favor, 65 against and four abstentions. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/catalonia-parliament-elects-quim-torra-as-new-regional-leader-idUSKCN1IF1MJ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-44109500 (BBC)]
